QE_CAPABILITIES.title: Test automation
QE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Automate functional, regression and integration testing to improve coverage, consistency and release confidence.

QE_CAPABILITIES.title: API & integration testing
QE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Validate APIs, services and system integrations to ensure applications exchange data and behave correctly across connected environments.

QE_CAPABILITIES.title: Performance engineering
QE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Identify performance constraints and optimize applications for speed, responsiveness, scalability and stability under real workloads.

QE_CAPABILITIES.title: Continuous testing
QE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Integrate testing into development and CI/CD pipelines so quality checks happen continuously rather than only before release.

QE_CAPABILITIES.title: Application quality assessment
QE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Evaluate existing applications to identify defects, technical risks, performance issues and opportunities for improvement.

QE_CAPABILITIES.title: Security testing
QE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Identify application-level security weaknesses and validate security controls as part of the engineering lifecycle.

QE_CAPABILITIES.title: AI-assisted quality engineering
QE_CAPABILITIES.desc: Use AI-assisted test generation, test analysis, defect analysis and code review to accelerate quality activities while keeping engineering judgment in control.

QE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Earlier defect detection
QE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Identify issues earlier in development when they are easier and less costly to fix.

QE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Higher test coverage
QE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Automate repeatable validation across applications, APIs, integrations and critical workflows.

QE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Reliable releases
QE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Give engineering teams greater confidence when releasing new features and changes.

QE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Better performance
QE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Measure and improve application behavior under realistic workloads and conditions.

QE_VALUE_ITEMS.title: Continuous quality
QE_VALUE_ITEMS.desc: Make quality part of everyday engineering rather than a final checkpoint.
